result:
The change would reach the REST module through five production call sites, plus about 25 test call sites that would fail or change behaviour with it.

**Production code (most likely affected)**

1. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_8/UserResource1_8.java:207-211`: `getByUniqueId` looks up the user and wraps it in `UserAndPassword1_8`. This is the main REST user-by-UUID path.
2. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/converter/openmrs1_8/UserConverter1_8.java:34-37`: `getByUniqueId` converts a UUID string to a `User`, so any REST resource that takes a user reference goes through it.
3. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/search/openmrs1_9/ProviderSearchHandler1_9.java:52-64`: `search` returns empty results when the `user` UUID resolves to null, so a change in null handling changes provider search results.
4. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs2_0/AlertRecipientResource2_0.java:84-93`: `setRecipientProperty` silently skips the recipient when the lookup returns null.
5. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/controller/openmrs1_8/ChangePasswordController1_8.java:67-85`: `changeOthersPassword` throws `NullPointerException` when the user is not found, and it runs the lookup under a temporary `GET_USERS` privilege.

**Test code (would break or need review)**

The tests assert on `getUserByUuid` results directly, so a behaviour change would show up there too. Several test ranges below are approximate (reference line only, or method start not read).

- `UserController1_8Test.java`: lines 202, 256, 266, 280, 288, 329, 439 (method ranges 253-270, 277-291, 437-444 read; others approximate).
- `UserController2_0Test.java`: lines 99, 155, 165, 215, 223, 264 (not read, so only reference lines are cited).
- `PasswordResetController2_2Test.java`: lines 51, 61, 102, 118 (method ranges 50-57, 60-69, 102-114, 117+ read).
- `ChangePasswordController1_8Test.java:42`, `UserResource2_0Test.java:35`, `UserResource1_9Test.java:36`, `AlertResource2_0Test.java:27`, `AlertController2_0Test.java:48`, `AlertRecipientController2_0Test.java:41`, `AlertRecipientResource2_0Test.java:23,46`.

The definitions are in openmrs-core: `UserService.java:109` (interface), `UserServiceImpl.java:662` (implementation), plus DAO layers `UserDAO.java:159`, `HibernateUserDAO.java:585`, `ContextDAO.java:70` and `HibernateContextDAO.java:256`.
